characters.title: Choose your character
characters.aysenurLede: The seaside's star — she makes everything brighter

home.title: Seaside
home.guestLede: The seaside is waiting. Sign in to get started.
home.milestoneNotice: The foundation is playable: lanes, jumping and pause. Obstacles, hearts and paws are on the way.
home.adminEnrolmentRequired: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for administrators. Turn it on to reach the admin area.

login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Welcome back!
login.reauthenticateForAdmin: The admin area needs a session that has passed two-factor authentication. Please sign in again.

register.title: Create account
register.heading: Join us!
register.lede: One minute, and you are on the beach.
register.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. Length matters more than anything else.
register.verificationNotice: We will verify your email after you register — check your spam folder too!
register.terms: By registering you accept the rules. The rule is simple: have fun.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.heading: Verify your email
verifyEmail.resent: A new code is on its way. The previous one no longer works.

twoFactor.title: Security code
twoFactor.heading: Security code
twoFactor.lede: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. Your account is a fortress.
twoFactor.recoveryLede: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each one works only once.
twoFactor.recoveryCodeHint: One of the codes you saved during setup.
twoFactor.footerNote: Two-factor authentication is recommended for everyone and mandatory for administrators.

forgotPassword.title: Forgotten password
forgotPassword.heading: Forgotten your password?
forgotPassword.lede: It happens. We will send a reset link — dry those tears.
forgotPassword.sent: If that address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your spam folder too.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password
resetPassword.lede: Try not to forget this one — or do, we will be here.
resetPassword.done: Your password has been changed. Every device has been signed out.
resetPassword.twoFactorUnaffected: Your two-factor authentication is untouched. Resetting a password never turns it off.
resetPassword.linkIncomplete: This link looks incomplete. Please request a new reset link.

security.title: Account and security
security.heading: Account and security
security.twoFactorOff: Off. We recommend turning it on; it makes your account a fortress.
security.disableWarning: With 2FA off, only your password protects the account, and your recovery codes are deleted.
security.adminTwoFactorMandatory: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for administrators and cannot be turned off.
security.adminEnrolmentRequired: You need to turn on two-factor authentication before you can reach the admin area.
security.twoFactorDisabled: Two-factor authentication has been turned off.
security.reauthenticateHint: We ask for your password again before changing a security setting.
security.scanInstruction: Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.qrAlt: QR code for two-factor authentication setup
security.manualEntry: If you cannot scan, enter this key by hand:
security.recoveryCodesNotice: Save these now. They will not be shown again, and each one works only once.
security.recoveryCodesAcknowledge: I have saved these codes somewhere safe.
security.noRecoveryCodesLeft: You have no recovery codes left. If you lose your authenticator you will be locked out — generate a new set.
security.regenerateWarning: Generating a new set makes every existing code stop working.
security.changePasswordNotice: Changing your password signs out your other devices. This one stays signed in.
security.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Other devices have been signed out.
security.sessionsLede: Devices signed in to your account. If you see one you do not recognise, sign it out and change your password.
security.revokeOthersHint: This also ends sessions you cannot see, which is why we ask for your password.

admin.title: Admin
admin.heading: Admin
admin.capabilitiesPending: Administrative capabilities arrive in {milestone}. For now this screen only proves access control works.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unexpected_with_reference: Something went wrong. Quote this reference if you report it: {reference}
errors.client_network_error: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.bff_upstream_timeout: The server did not respond in time. Please try again.
errors.bff_upstream_unavailable: The service is unreachable right now. Try again shortly.
errors.bff_csrf_token_mismatch: Your session was refreshed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.bff_origin_rejected: This request was not accepted. Reload the page and try again.
errors.bff_session_unavailable: Your session could not be stored. Please try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.invalid_credentials: That email or password is not correct.
errors.forbidden: You are not permitted to do that.
errors.conflict: That conflicts with the current state. Reload the page and try again.
errors.rate_limited: That was a bit fast. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.server_error: Something failed on our side. Please try again.
errors.service_unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
errors.email_already_verified: That email address is already verified.
errors.verification_code_invalid: That code is not correct. Try again.
errors.verification_code_expired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.verification_code_missing: There is no code outstanding. Request a new one.
errors.verification_resend_cooldown: We sent a code just now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.two_factor_challenge_invalid: That verification step has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.two_factor_code_invalid: That code is not correct. Check your authenticator app.
errors.admin_two_factor_mandatory: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for administrators and cannot be turned off.
errors.admin_role_required: That area is for administrators only.
errors.admin_two_factor_required: The admin area needs a session that has passed two-factor authentication.
errors.reset_token_invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.display_name_change_cooldown: You changed your display name recently. Please wait a while.

default.too_short: That needs to be a bit longer.
default.too_long: That needs to be a bit shorter.
default.confirmation_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
default.password_compromised: That password has appeared in a known data breach. Choose a different one.
default.type_invalid: That value is not the expected type.

display_name.taken: That display name is taken. Try another.
display_name.format_invalid: 3–20 characters: letters, digits, and _ . - It needs at least one letter and cannot start or end with punctuation.

email.taken: An account with that email already exists.

password.too_short: Your password needs at least 12 characters.
password.too_long: Your password can be at most 128 characters.
password.password_compromised: That password has appeared in a known data breach. Choose a different one.

password_confirmation.confirmation_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

current_password.password_incorrect: Your current password is not correct.
current_password.required: Enter your current password to continue.

notFound.title: This page is not here
notFound.body: The link may be out of date, or the address mistyped.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: An unexpected error occurred. Try again in a moment.

errors.run_not_active: That run has already ended and can't be saved again.
errors.idempotency_key_reused: That run was already submitted with different results.
errors.bff_run_finish_pending: Your previous run is still being saved.
errors.bff_invalid_request: That request couldn't be sent. Reload the page and try again.

run.title: Run
run.surfaceLabel: Seaside festival run surface: three lanes, character in the centre.
run.failed: The game engine could not load. Refresh the page and try again.

complete.title: GAME OVER!
complete.flavour: Ayşenur is catching her breath. The seaside is still here.

run.slayyyHint: Press E or tap to activate
run.nextGoalNote: The Loli Bonus is getting closer!

start.blocked: Your previous run hasn't been saved yet. We'll keep trying — a new run starts once it's saved.
start.offline: You need a connection to start a run.
start.failed: We couldn't start a run right now.
start.resumed: Your unfinished run restarts on the same course.
start.previousSaved: Your previous run has been saved.

submit.retrying: We'll save this run when you're back online — keep this page open.

outcome.flagged: This run was recorded, but it doesn't count toward records or progress.
outcome.closed: This run could no longer be recorded.

reason.value_out_of_domain: Its numbers were outside anything a run can produce.
reason.duration_non_positive: It reported no playing time at all.
reason.duration_exceeds_server_window: It reported more playing time than had actually passed.
reason.score_below_paw_floor: Its score was lower than its Paw Tokens alone are worth.
reason.score_rate_high: Its score rose faster than a run normally allows.
reason.paw_rate_high: It collected Paw Tokens faster than a run normally allows.
reason.score_below_duration_floor: Its score was unusually low for how long it lasted.
reason.duration_below_minimum: It ended sooner than a run normally can.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.surfaceLabel: Tutorial area: three lanes, Ayşenur in the middle.
tutorial.saveFailed: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.

dodgeCone.title: A cone! Change lane
dodgeCone.touch: Swipe sideways to get around it

collectPaw.title: Collect the Paw Token
collectPaw.keyboard: Move across and run over it
collectPaw.touch: Swipe across and run over it

correction.noInput: Give it a go — don't worry, nothing can hurt you here.
correction.jumpedAtCone: You can't jump over the cone! Move to another lane.
correction.contactedCone: You hit the cone. Go around it, not over it.
correction.dodgedBarrier: You went around the barrier. Try jumping it this time!
correction.contactedBarrier: You hit the barrier. A jump clears it.
correction.missedPaw: The Paw got away! Change lane and run over it.

skipConfirm.title: Skip the tutorial?
skipConfirm.body: You can replay it later from Settings.

complete.title: You're ready! ⭐
complete.skipped: Tutorial skipped. You can replay it from Settings.
